website_metadata.notes: Payments Bank — legally cannot offer term/fixed deposits (RBI Payments Bank licence). Official 'Rate of Interest w.e.f. 16 January 2026' PDF (jiopayments.bank.in/docs/.../rate-of-interest-wef-16-january-2026.pdf) covers ONLY savings interest: <=Rs.1 lakh 0.50%, >Rs.1 lakh 4.00%. Balances above ~INR 1.95 lakh swept to partner Suryoday SFB. 'Savings Pro' uses overnight funds (not an FD). Aggregator 'FD rates' listings (codeforbanks) are fabricated.

warnings: Re-verified: no FD product exists for this Payments Bank; only savings-account interest published.
